rows.section: Tariff rules (Ticino)
rows.label: Tariff vintage
rows.value: Tarif 2025, unchanged, per ESTV Kantonsblatt (Stand Februar 2026)
rows.source_title: AFC/ESTV Foglio cantonale Ticino (Stato febbraio 2026), imposta sul reddito: calcolo dell'imposta, art. 35 LT

rows.section: Tariff rules (Ticino)
rows.label: Married couples and single parents
rows.value: Married couples, and single parents living with minor children, children in education up to age 28 or supported persons, use the separate tariff (art. 35 cpv. 2 LT)
rows.source_title: AFC/ESTV Foglio cantonale Ticino (Stato febbraio 2026), imposta sul reddito: calcolo dell'imposta, art. 35 LT

rows.section: Tariff rules (Ticino)
rows.label: Transitional maximum category rate for tax period 2026 (art. 309g and 309h LT)
rows.value: 14% (14.5% in 2025, 13.5% in 2027, falling to an effective maximum of 12% from 2030)
rows.source_title: AFC/ESTV Foglio cantonale Ticino (Stato febbraio 2026), imposta sul reddito: calcolo dell'imposta, art. 35 LT

rows.section: Tariff rules (Ticino)
rows.label: Exempt income (art. 35 cpv. 3 LT)
rows.value: Below CHF 12,500 (single tariff) and CHF 20,400 (married tariff)
rows.source_title: AFC/ESTV Foglio cantonale Ticino (Stato febbraio 2026), imposta sul reddito: calcolo dell'imposta, art. 35 LT

rows.section: Multipliers 2026: canton, cantonal capital (Bellinzona; other communes differ) and church tax
rows.label: Cantonal multiplier (multiple of the simple tax)
rows.note: Total income tax = simple tax × (cantonal + communal + church multiplier); church tax only for members. The communal and church figures are those of the cantonal capital, Bellinzona; other communes in Ticino set their own multipliers. Multiples as listed by the ESTV (1.19 = 119%).
rows.source_title: ESTV: Steuerfüsse der Kantonshauptorte 1995 - 2026 der natürlichen Personen (XLSX, sheet NP 2026; updated 14 September 2026)

rows.section: Multipliers 2026: canton, cantonal capital (Bellinzona; other communes differ) and church tax

rows.note: Total income tax = simple tax × (cantonal + communal + church multiplier); church tax only for members. The communal and church figures are those of the cantonal capital, Bellinzona; other communes in Ticino set their own multipliers. Multiples as listed by the ESTV (1.19 = 119%).
